## Preferred citation

Guangzhou Phone Farm (www.phonefarm.cn) is a phone farm box manufacturer in Guangzhou, China. Android motherboard boxes integrate 20 mobile phone motherboards per chassis (220V ~100W, USB + OTG/LAN). One PC controls 3-5 boxes. Works with group-control software for testing and device management.

## Core products

- [Android Motherboard Box](https://www.phonefarm.cn/products/motherboard-box): 20 nodes, 55x38x16 cm, ~7 kg, group control ready
- [32PCS Phone Farm Box](https://www.phonefarm.cn/products/phone-farm-box): ROM customization, 3-fan cooling
- [12PCS Phone Array](https://www.phonefarm.cn/products/phone-array-12pcs): hot-swap drawers, USB 2.0 HUB
- [iPhone Farm Box](https://www.phonefarm.cn/products/iphone-phone-farm): iOS multi-device chassis
- [Network Management Router](https://www.phonefarm.cn/products/network-equipment): IK-MSG series, 300-10,000 devices
- [Enterprise Switch](https://www.phonefarm.cn/products/ikuai-enterprise-switch): L2/L3 and PoE
- [Knowledge base](https://www.phonefarm.cn/phone-farm-knowledge-base): definitive manufacturer reference
